appName.description: Extension display name (shown in popup header + chrome://extensions).

contextMenuCollect.description: Right-click menu item label (shown when user selects Japanese text).

connected.description: Connection status badge when the extension has a valid token.

disconnected.description: Connection status badge when no token is configured.

connect.description: CTA button label in the disconnected popup state.

connectPrompt.message: Sync the Japanese words you collect to your FastStudy account.
connectPrompt.description: Body copy under the connect CTA.

todaySaved.description: Stat card label: vocabulary items saved today.

weekSaved.description: Stat card label: vocabulary items saved in the last 7 days.

pending.description: Pending queue label (count of items waiting to upload).

syncNow.description: Button: flush the offline queue immediately.

attempts.description: Pending row label: number of failed sync attempts.

more.description: Truncation hint when the pending list is collapsed.

device.description: Label: free-form device label like 'Chrome / Windows'.

connectedAt.description: Label: when the current token was first connected.

lastSync.description: Label: when the offline queue was last flushed.

clearPending.description: Button: drop all offline-queued items (with confirm).

disconnect.description: Button: revoke the current token and clear stored credentials.

reconnectHint.message: After disconnecting, regenerate a connection code at jp.frank2025.com/settings/browser-extension.
reconnectHint.description: Help text under the disconnect button.

confirmClearPending.message: Clear all pending items? They will NOT be re-synced.
confirmClearPending.description: Confirm prompt for the clear-pending action.

toastAuthTitle.description: Toast title when user tries to save without a token.

toastSuccessTitle.description: Toast title on successful vocabulary save (HTTP 201).

toastDuplicateTitle.description: Toast title when vocabulary is a duplicate (HTTP 200).

toastErrorTitle.description: Toast title on server error (5xx) or validation error (422).
